name: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips
tagline: VERTICAL EDGE CLIP FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips is an accessory used to hold a 20 mm thick paver horizontally to construct the raised flooring fascia. Vertical edge clips are manufactured from aluminium, and this clip holds the the top of the fascia paver at the finished paver layer. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and SikaRoof® VersiJack® Vertical Paver Clips Base and is installed between the top of pedestals and beneath the pavers.
